region_policy.digital_pages: Reference regions target visually separable text or paragraph groups where useful, visually identifiable headings, coherent outer tables for table localization, and actual visible figures, diagrams, maps, or symbol sheets at the selected physical-audit granularity.
region_policy.list_items: LIST_ITEM is used only when the individual item is the chosen physical audit granularity.
region_policy.marginal_regions: HEADER, FOOTER, and PAGE_NUMBER are used when those regions are visually identifiable and relevant to the selected page audit.
region_policy.scanned_pages: Page modality is recorded separately; a full-page raster is not an OCR text region.
region_policy.text: Text is empty unless visually verified transcription is needed; layout scoring uses region geometry and type.
